metadata.description: Generic Claude Code plugins for AI engineering workflows. NotebookLM integration (notebooklm-kit) and pedagogical kit (learn-kit: 8-stage methodology + AI 3-tier learning doc generator + interactive HTML rendering). Tested with mj-system and mj-agent.

plugins.name: notebooklm-kit
plugins.description: NotebookLM integration: notebook lifecycle, artifact generation (audio/video/slides/mind-map/quiz/...), learn-make and learn-test wrappers. Renamed from mj-nlm at marketplace v3.0.0.

plugins.name: learn-kit
plugins.description: Pedagogical kit for learnable knowledge artifacts. Includes (1) 8-stage manual authoring methodology, (2) AI-driven three-tier (foundation/structural/challenge) learning doc generator with optional interactive HTML rendering, (3) discovery skills (locate concept reverse-lookup + scan project-wide enumeration). Independent plugin — no external service dependencies.
